summary: Iter16 LocationPickerModal geolocation-error redesign verified 100% — all 5 FIX scenarios pass and all 3 regressions hold. FIX-1 (framed context): loading the app via a data:URL wrapper iframe correctly triggers isInsideCrossOriginIframe() → the amber location-picker-frame-notice with location-picker-open-new-tab-btn is rendered proactively; after clicking use-current-btn (with getCurrentPosition mocked to reject code=1 + isSecureContext overridden true), the error box has data-error-kind='iframe', text contains 'preview frame', and location-picker-open-new-tab-btn-from-error is rendered inside the error box. FIX-2 (top-level, geolocation granted): url-input populated with 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=12.971600,77.594600' exactly; no error; frame notice NOT shown. FIX-3 (permissions API denied): mocked navigator.permissions.query({name:'geolocation'})={state:'denied'}; error appears with data-error-kind='denied', text does NOT include 'preview frame', text mentions padlock + Site settings. FIX-4 (TIMEOUT retry): mocked getCurrentPosition to reject with code=3 on first call and succeed on second — window.__gp_calls === 2, url-input filled with 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=10.000000,20.000000', no error shown (retry was transparent). FIX-5 (POSITION_UNAVAILABLE): mocked to reject code=2; error appears with data-error-kind='unavailable' and mentions 'GPS/Location is turned ON'. Regressions: 'Open Google Maps to search' opens https://www.google.com/maps in new tab; pasting https://maps.app.goo.gl/testabc + Save closes modal (via evaluate() click due to iter15-documented Playwright quirk on the modal Save btn) and writes to onboarding-location-display; customer /provider/8fc7a9b9-… still renders provider-directions-btn with href='https://maps.app.goo.gl/abc123' (iter15 seed) target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.

FIX-1 framed cross-origin iframe + PERMI.evidence: data:text/html;base64,<iframe src='REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/provider/onboarding'></iframe> loaded → isInsideCrossOriginIframe()===true (verified via 3 frames present, app frame is cross-origin from data: URL). location-picker-frame-notice VISIBLE with location-picker-open-new-tab-btn VISIBLE. After overriding window.isSecureContext=true (needed because data: parent taints the iframe's secure-context inheritance — not a product issue) and mocking navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition to error with {code:1,message:'User denied Geolocation'}, click use-current-btn → error kind='iframe', text='The preview frame does not have permission to read location. Tap Open in a new tab below — the app will then prompt you for permission.', location-picker-open-new-tab-btn-from-error rendered inside the rose error box.

FIX-2 top-level geolocation granted.evidence: context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) + context.set_geolocation({lat:12.9716,lng:77.5946}). Modal opened at /provider/onboarding (top-level). Frame notice absent. Click use-current-btn → url-input value exactly 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=12.971600,77.594600'; no error rendered.

FIX-3 permissions API preflight denied (.evidence: Monkey-patched navigator.permissions.query to return {state:'denied'} for {name:'geolocation'}. Click use-current-btn → error kind='denied', text='Location permission is blocked in your browser settings for this site. Tap the padlock icon in the address bar → Site settings → Location → Allow, then try again. Or paste a Maps link below.' — 'preview frame' NOT present; padlock + site settings both present.

FIX-4 TIMEOUT auto-retry with lower accu.evidence: Counted invocations via window.__gp_calls; first call errored with {code:3}, second call succeeded with fake coords {lat:10,lng:20}. Result: __gp_calls===2, url-input='https://www.google.com/maps?q=10.000000,20.000000', location-picker-error absent. Retry is transparent to the user.

FIX-5 POSITION_UNAVAILABLE.evidence: Mocked getCurrentPosition to reject with {code:2,message:'unavailable'}. Error kind='unavailable', text='Your device could not determine a location right now. Check that GPS/Location is turned ON in your phone settings, then try again.' — contains 'GPS' and 'Location is turned ON'.

critical_code_review_comments: LocationPickerModal.jsx L23-30 isInsideCrossOriginIframe(): the check 'window.self !== window.top && !window.top.document' is correct but the '!window.top.document' branch is unreachable in modern browsers because reading a cross-origin window.top.document ALWAYS throws SecurityError — the catch{} correctly handles this. The '!window.top.document' clause is dead code but harmless; leave for defense-in-depth or drop with a comment.
LocationPickerModal.jsx L88 catch{} on navigator.permissions.query — perfect; Safari<16 and some older WebKit throw NotSupportedError on unknown names. Good.

LocationPickerModal.jsx L113 maximumAge: 60000 — reasonable but may return a slightly stale location on the retry path. Consider maximumAge: 0 for the second attempt if that path is chosen to force a fresh network-based fix. Minor.
LocationPickerModal.jsx L129 lat/lng formatted to fixed(6) is good — ~11cm precision, avoids floating-point representation issues in the URL.
LocationPickerModal.jsx openInNewTab() uses window.location.href — inside an iframe this correctly resolves to the iframe's URL (NOT the parent's). Good. window.open with noopener,noreferrer is safe.

Test-tooling: same Playwright event-dispatch quirk seen on onboarding-save-btn (iter15) also affects location-picker-save-btn — must use page.evaluate((sel)=>document.querySelector(sel).click(), '[data-testid="location-picker-save-btn"]') for reliable dispatch. Suggest adding this to the shared test helpers for future runs. Product code unaffected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 all-green. LocationPickerModal now handles 5 distinct error classifications with data-error-kind attribute: 'iframe', 'denied', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'other'. The framed-context detection uses try/catch on window.top.document — a data:URL wrapper works as an OK proxy for cross-origin (frame notice appears correctly). BUT: a data:URL parent taints the iframe's secure-context inheritance (window.isSecureContext becomes false inside the iframe), which trips the pre-flight secure-context guard at L72-76 BEFORE the iframe-classified branch can fire. To fully validate the code=1 PERMISSION_DENIED → kind='iframe' path in Playwright, override window.isSecureContext AND mock navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition to reject with {code:1} inside the iframe. In real Emergent chat preview (HTTPS parent iframing HTTPS app without allow='geolocation'), isSecureContext will genuinely be true, so this test workaround is only for local automation. IMPORTANT: location-picker-save-btn has the same locator.click(force=True)→no-React-onClick quirk as onboarding-save-btn — use page.evaluate() to click both.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration verified the mitigation for the Android 'permission denied' user report. Root cause was correctly identified upstream: cross-origin iframe without allow='geolocation' → browser rejects getCurrentPosition() with PERMISSION_DENIED instantly, regardless of the user's OS/browser permissions. The frontend-only mitigation in LocationPickerModal.jsx correctly (a) detects the framed context up-front (via try/catch on window.top.document, verified via frame_notice_present=True in an iframe wrapper), (b) proactively surfaces an amber warning with an 'Open in a new tab' button before the user even clicks (verified), (c) classifies the eventual PERMISSION_DENIED as 'iframe' rather than the generic 'denied' when framed (verified via data-error-kind='iframe' and 'preview frame' text), (d) shows a second contextual 'Open in a new tab' button inside the rose error box (verified). All classifications are actionable and distinct — no false-negative for the reported user scenario.
